validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a" initial="a1"><history id="h"><transition target="a1"/><transition target="a2"/></history><state id="a1"><transition event="go" target="a2"/></state><state id="a2"><transition event="back" target="f"/></state></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: history must contain exactly one transition, but has 2
notes: the history transition defines the default configuration used before the parent state was ever exited
diagnostics.help: keep one `<transition>` in `<history>`; to enter several states at once, list them all in its `target` (for example `target="a b"` across parallel regions)
